<h2>Load a Versioned sjSDM Artifact</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads the canonical v2 target first and falls back to a documented v1
target group that is upgraded by a pure converter.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_sjsdm_versioned_artifact(
  store_path = NULL,
  v2_target_name = NULL,
  v1_target_names = NULL,
  artifact_type = NULL,
  converter_function = NULL,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="store_path">store_path</code></td>
<td>
<p>Targets store path.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="v2_target_name">v2_target_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Canonical v2 target name.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="v1_target_names">v1_target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Documented v1 target names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="artifact_type">artifact_type</code></td>
<td>
<p>Expected artifact type.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="converter_function">converter_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Function accepting the named v1 target bundle.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target reader.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Validated native or converted v2 artifact.
</p>

</main>
